1.text: Jyewe Umukuru, ndakwandikiye Gayo ukundwa, uwo nkunda by'ukuri.

2.text: Ukundwa, ndagusabira kugira ngo ugubwe neza muri byose, ube mutaraga nk'uko umutima wawe uguwe neza,

3.text: kuko nishimiye cyane ubwo bene Data bazaga, bagahamya uburyo ushikamye mu kuri ukakugenderamo.

4.text: Nta cyantera umunezero waruta uwo kumva ko abana banjye bagendera mu kuri.

5.text: Ukundwa, ukiranuka mu byo ukorera bene Data byose kandi ari abashyitsi

6.text: bahamije urukundo rwawe mu maso y'Itorero. Uzaba ugize neza nubaherekeza neza nk'uko bikwiriye ab'Imana,

7.text: kuko bavuye iwabo ku bw'izina rya Yesu ari nta cyo bātse abanyamahanga.

8.text: Ni cyo gituma dukwiriye kwakira neza abameze batyo, kugira ngo dufatanye gukorera ukuri.

9.text: Hari icyo nandikiye Itorero, ariko Diyotirefe ushaka kuba ukomeye muri bo araturosera.

10.text: Ni cyo gituma ubwo nzaza, nzabibutsa ibyo akora n'uko atuvuga amagambo mabi y'ubupfu, nyamara ibyo ntibimunyura ahubwo arengaho akanga no gucumbikira bene Data, n'ababishaka akababuza akabaca mu Itorero.

11.text: Ukundwa, ntukīgane ikibi ahubwo wīgane icyiza. Ukora ibyiza ni we w'Imana, naho ukora ibibi ntiyari yabona Imana.

12.text: Demeteriyo ahamywa na bose kandi n'ukuri ubwako kuramuhamya natwe turamuhamya, nawe uzi yuko ibyo duhamya ari iby'ukuri.

13.text: Nari mfite byinshi byo kukwandikira ariko sinshaka kukwandikishiriza wino n'ikaramu,

14.text: ahubwo niringiye kuzakubona vuba tukavugana duhanganye.

15.text: Urasigare amahoro.Incuti ziragutashya. Untahirize incuti uzivuze mu mazina.
